milestone_full: Layer S is OPEN: 178 Hong Kong chapters ship in three arms (Traditional HK / opencc Simplified fold / full English prose), locked step with a derived atlas (178/178/178, the fence reads its own number off the index). World Answer now has a deep-read mode: quick 8x520 vs deep 20x1350 chunks, LIVE 30,493 prompt tokens at 90.0% provider cache on the deep lane (25,448 / 90.0% quick) via api.aizzz.xyz. The script law went whole-repo: a 3,873-character opencc-derived inventory now polices every zh-HK literal - UI census 2,962 literals and the 178-chapter corpus 10,848 literals, both measured 0 simplified; the 93 dirty corpus literals found on first contact were repaired. 76 readers reachable, verify_all PASS 73 / FAIL 0, web vitest 974/974 in 97 files, AI vocabulary census 0 unknown characters. 1,795 commits.
headline: Layer S open · 178 chapters · deep-read 30k tokens @90% cache · whole-repo script law (3,873-char inventory, 13,810 literals clean) · 76 readers green.
features: D1536: AI test fixtures brought under the vocabulary census - 0 unknown characters across every tests/*.py data string (was: 3 unknown code points shipped in a D1514 fixture, 2 more from parallel lanes).

D1535: whole-repo script law - gen_simp_only_chars.py derives 3,873 Simplified-only characters from opencc's own tables (s2t rule, byte-reproducible, --check in gate); new check_corpus_script.mjs reads all 10,848 chapter literals (first run: 93 dirty, 56 repaired + 4 more found by measuring bigrams); check_ui_script refuses to silently fall back to its old 239-pair table.

D1534: the atlas fence stopped lying - routes_chapter derives 'THE N-CHAPTER HONG KONG ARC' from the index instead of writing a literal (it said 175 while the corpus held 178); the lockstep reader now treats a literal digit there as the offender; guide fallback can never IndexError on zero candidates.
D1514: World Answer deep-read mode - depth whitelist quick(8x520)/deep(20x1350) with server-side budgets returned to the client; LIVE measured 30,493 prompt tokens / 90.0% cache hit on deep.

D1513: admin behaviour lane live - /admin/analytics monitors real user behaviour events (rage-clicks, abandonment) with a tri-lingual demo badge; every nav href verified to answer a real page (22 legs).
privacy_note: All consumer fixtures are synthetic (demo flags); no real merchant, stall or operator is represented. /insights replay is deterministic synthetic inference, not stored user data. All REAL-HK figures are public sources with URLs inline on the handbook page.
milestone_full_zh: Layer S（第二層）已開啟：178 章香港系列以三語臂呈現（繁體香港／opencc 簡體／完整英文），與圖譜鎖步（178/178/178，圍欄數字由索引自行推導）。跨章問答新增深讀模式：速讀 8×520 對深讀 20×1350，實測深讀通道 30,493 prompt tokens、供應商快取命中 90.0%（速讀 25,448／90.0%），經 api.aizzz.xyz 實打。字形法令覆蓋全倉：3,873 字 opencc 派生清單巡查所有 zh-HK 字面量——UI 普查 2,962 條、178 章語料 10,848 條，實測皆為零簡體；首跑發現的 93 條髒字面量已全部修復。76 個讀器全部可達，verify_all PASS 73／FAIL 0，web vitest 974/974（97 檔），AI 詞彙普查零未知字符。累計 1,795 次提交。
headline_zh: Layer S 開啟 · 178 章 · 深讀 30k token、快取 90% · 全倉字形法令（3,873 字清單、13,810 字面量零簡體）· 76 個讀器全綠。
features_zh: D1536：AI 測試治具納入詞彙普查——全部 tests/*.py 資料字串零未知字符（此前 D1514 治具攜帶 3 個未知碼位、並行通道另帶 2 個）。
D1535：全倉字形法令——gen_simp_only_chars.py 由 opencc 自身資料派生 3,873 個僅簡字符（s2t 判據、字節級可復現、--check 進閘門）；新 check_corpus_script.mjs 巡查全部 10,848 條章節字面量（首跑 93 條髒、修復 56 條＋用雙字測量再抓 4 條）；check_ui_script 不再靜默退回舊 239 對表。
D1534：圖譜圍欄停止說謊——routes_chapter 的「THE N-CHAPTER HONG KONG ARC」由索引推導而非寫死（原文寫 175 而語料已是 178）；鎖步讀器把此處的字面數字視為違規；向導後備在零候選時永不 IndexError。
D1514：跨章問答深讀模式——depth 白名單 quick(8×520)／deep(20×1350)，服務端預算回傳客戶端；實測深讀 30,493 prompt tokens、快取命中 90.0%。
D1513：管理員行為通道上線——/admin/analytics 監控真實用戶行為事件（連環亂點、中途離開），三語 demo 徽章；每個導航 href 都有真實頁面應答（22 條檢查）。
